title: AccessStage::Asking is a bare flag: the popup answer is matched by PopupPurpose::EmojiStatusAccess, not by an id held in the stage
trigger: A mini app asks for emoji status access; the popup is shown and PopupClosed is routed by purpose via window.popups[id]
effect: No bug today (one popup at a time, replaced popups are answered as dismissed), but the stage cannot tell its own popup from another
fix: Asking { popup: PopupId } checked when the PopupClosed arrives, and the popups map keyed by that id

title: SetStage::Resolving { request: Option<RequestId> } uses the Option as a 'lookup sent yet' flag; resolve_suggested_emoji re-sends from the poll tick while it is None
trigger: web_app_set_emoji_status while the shared custom-emoji lookup is busy
effect: The poll re-asks every 250 ms tick until the lookup goes out or 15 s pass; no stuck state, but two stages are folded in one
fix: Queued / Asked { request } as two variants

title: WriteAccess::Asking is a bare variant: the consent popup answer is matched by PopupPurpose::WriteAccess
trigger: A mini app requests write access and the bot needs consent
effect: No bug today; the answer is routed by purpose, not by the popup the stage opened

title: baseline: PhoneFlow::Asking is a bare in-flight variant (stage-enums baseline); the answer is matched by PopupPurpose::Phone
LaunchFlow::Searching/FetchingAttachBot/Adding have no way out when their request is dropped without an answer
trigger: Open a named app link (t.me/bot/app), then the request is dropped by the stale sweep or a reconnect; no found/attachment answer is ever pushed
effect: flow.is_waiting() stays true so poll_mini_apps never ends and the mini-app poll keeps waking at the 5 s ceiling for the rest of the session (also while hidden/locked); the launch silently never happens. Only a newer launch replaces it. emoji_status.rs handles exactly this dropped case for its Granting stage; the flow does not
effect_note: worst case wasted wakeups and a dead tap
fix: Check session.requests.get(awaited.request) in poll_mini_apps and end the stage with an error note when it left flight

title: MiniApps::generation is a counter that tells old poll wake-ups from the current one while the poll Task is already held in MiniApps::poll
effect: No bug today; a second source of truth beside the held Task (round-3 'counter' shape)
fix: Drop generation; the held Task is cancelled when poll is replaced or cleared

title: Poll::Asking(request) never leaves flight if TDLib drops the poll request without a PublicData answer
trigger: A watching widget polls (schedule_widget_polls sets Asking); the request is dropped by the stale sweep / reconnect
effect: The widget stops refreshing its public data for as long as the entry lives (Asking is skipped by schedule_widget_polls; came_back only re-arms Due); only replace_content or the entry being removed resets it
fix: Treat Asking(request) with a request no longer in session.requests as Due(now + DEFAULT_POLL_PERIOD) in schedule_widget_polls

title: Cancelling a wallpaper preview while Share is out leaves its answer in background_answers
trigger: Preview > Share, then Cancel before the link arrives
effect: close_wallpaper_preview drops the stage but nothing forgets the Sharing request; the late BackgroundOutcome::Link stays in session.chats_state.background_answers (only ids in `waiting` are ever taken), a small leak
fix: Forget the Sharing request in close_wallpaper_preview (as phone.rs forgets acks)

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on the APPLIED thread-local (sync and the window-gone closure)
trigger: sync() running re-entrantly with the deferred removal
effect: Panic only if both borrow at once; the removal runs through cx.defer so it cannot overlap today
fix: try_borrow_mut like the other thread-locals in the UI

title: baseline: UpdateControl::Downloading is an unkeyed in-flight variant (stage-enums baseline); it is a per-render view of UpdateState::Downloading, which holds the Job
effect: No bug today: the view is derived every render from UpdateState; the real stage owns the task and DownloadProgress
fix: Leave as a derived view (move to stage-enums-allow with that reason) or drop the variant and read UpdateState directly

title: A VoiceCapture dropped without finish/discard leaves its recording on disk (VideoNoteCapture removes its file in Drop; VoiceCapture does not)
trigger: Start a voice note, then switch account / lose the composer / quit while recording so the capture is dropped
effect: Drop stops the mic and detaches the encoder, which finishes the OGG; the file stays in the captures folder, unreferenced, until the media cache sweep
fix: Drop removes the path unless the capture was finished or is a fixture, like VideoNoteCapture::Capture::Finished
